findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Specify that test_every_make_lint_script_is_listed extracts the bare `scripts/check_*.py` path (stripping `--check` and any argv) before testing membership in _WIRED_GATES, so flagged invocations (check_complexity_baseline/mechanism_delta/docs_index) match the bare entries.
evidence: Makefile:273 `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check`, Makefile:285 `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check`
Plan: 'Add python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check directly below the check_verify_gate_parity.py line'
_WIRED_GATES entries are bare paths: tests/unit/test_make_lint_hygiene_wiring.py:26-29 ('scripts/check_raw_git_writes.py', ...)
Plan: the reverse test 'parses the lint recipe ... for every python scripts/check_*.py invocation and asserts each is in _WIRED_GATES' — no mention of flag-stripping
findings.finding: The new reverse-direction census test (test_every_make_lint_script_is_listed) parses the lint recipe for `python scripts/check_*.py` and asserts each is in _WIRED_GATES, whose entries are bare paths (e.g. scripts/check_docs_index.py). But three lint invocations carry flags — check_complexity_baseline.py --check, check_mechanism_delta.py --check, and the plan's newly-added check_docs_index.py --check. The plan does not specify that the parser must strip the flag/argv to the bare script path before the membership test, so a naive token capture would compare 'scripts/check_docs_index.py --check' against bare _WIRED_GATES entries and fail spuriously.
findings.location: Approach, 'Add a third census test, test_every_make_lint_script_is_listed'; AC2
scenarios: Census test run against the real Makefile where flagged invocations (--check) are present fails because the captured token includes the flag and does not equal the bare _WIRED_GATES entry.
findings.suggested_fix: State that the recipe parser captures only the `scripts/check_<name>.py` token (splitting on whitespace / regex `scripts/check_\w+\.py`) and compares that bare path against _WIRED_GATES, mirroring how the forward-direction substring check already tolerates trailing flags.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Reconcile the census/node counts with the parent: update parent f400-65b3-1899-4af9 AC3 and the S3 comment from '28 lint-target scripts' / '74 ... twin nodes' to the re-measured 25 / 67 (re-staling the parent's plan-review attestation), or re-state the leaf's counts to the parent's figures.
evidence: Parent AC3: '... the single wiring census over all 28 lint-target scripts'
Parent S3 comment: 'delete the 74 real-tree/wiring twin nodes of table (3) ... make _WIRED_GATES the 28-script census'
Leaf: 'the 23 scripts make -n lint runs on 8dc66112c63 ... + check_adr_numbers + check_docs_index = 25 (the earlier "25 + 3 = 28" miscounted ...)'
Leaf: 'Delete the 67 collected nodes named in table (3) as amended here (72 at 083620b0 ...)'
CONFLICT RULE: the parent is authoritative; a count the leaf believes wrong should be fixed by updating the parent first, not by silently diverging the leaf.
findings.finding: The leaf's _WIRED_GATES census size (25) and deleted-node count (67) contradict the parent epic's AC3 ('the single wiring census over all 28 lint-target scripts') and S3 child-decomposition comment ('delete the 74 real-tree/wiring twin nodes ... make _WIRED_GATES the 28-script census'); the leaf re-measures on 8dc66112c63 after sibling S2 and the MCP epic landed but does not reconcile the parent's figures, so the leaf silently diverges from the parent contract instead of updating it.
findings.location: Approach / '_WIRED_GATES' and node-count paragraphs; parent f400-65b3-1899-4af9 AC3 and S3 child-decomposition comment
scenarios: A reviewer reconciling the leaf against the parent AC3 sees 25 vs 28 and 67 vs 74 and cannot tell whether the leaf under-delivers or the parent is stale.
The parent's AC3 ('28 lint-target scripts') will fail its own acceptance check after the leaf lands with 25.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the parent epic's AC3 to '25 lint-target scripts' and the S3 child-decomposition comment to '67 ... twin nodes', recording that S2 and the MCP epic already deleted the difference, so the parent and leaf agree.
